purpose: Add a separately labeled hosted reference ceiling without changing the local-serving north star or mixing causal denominators.

reference_model.current_official_guidance: Luna is intended for clear, repeatable, high-volume and focused coding tasks; xhigh is for demanding reasoning when supported.

known_non_equivalences: Hosted Codex system prompts and orchestration are not the local MLX runtime.
Reasoning tokens, tokenizer, context implementation, latency, and monetary cost differ by model and surface.
Equal output/action budgets do not imply equal training compute or inference FLOPs.
The hosted reference is an engineering ceiling and robustness check, not a serving candidate or local-model falsifier.
current_blocker: No callable gpt-5.6-luna transport is exposed inside the current experiment harness; bind an approved ChatGPT, Codex, or OpenAI API adapter before execution.
